Carlos A. Gimenez marks Oct. 7 with posts on Israel attack and Venezuela opposition
U.S. Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez marked October 7 by posting about Hamas' attack against Israel and extending congratulations to Venezuelan leader María Corina Machado via Twitter/X on October 7, 2026.
Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez, currently serving in the U.S. Congress representing Florida’s 28th district since 2021, posted a series of statements on October 7, 2026, addressing recent events and personal acknowledgments.
On October 7, 2026, Gimenez commented on the anniversary of the Hamas attack against Israel: "On #Oct7, Hamas committed the deadliest attack against the Jewish people since the Holocaust. We will NEVER forget. In Congress, I have always fought against antisemitic hate in all of its forms & proudly defend our unbreakable alliance with the democratic, Jewish State of https://t.co/g1qSdYMVDP".
Later that day, he extended birthday wishes to Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado: "¡Muchísimas felicidades a mi gran amiga María Corina Machado, la libertadora de #Venezuela, en su cumpleaños! Ya pronto estará reencontrándose con sus compatriotas en su patria que sufre — para terminar con este régimen por una vez y por todas. Wishing the happiest of https://t.co/QcGvvaGUxi".
In another post on October 7, Gimenez praised Marco for his leadership: "Marco is giving the world a master class in leadership & demonstrating how America must continue to engage closely with our allies to defeat our common enemies! https://t.co/vJepLnv50V".
Gimenez has served in Congress since replacing Debbie Mucarsel-Powell in 2021 and previously held positions in both the Florida House of Representatives and Miami-Dade County Commission from 2005 to 2011. He was born in Havana, Cuba in 1954 and currently resides in Miami. Gimenez earned his Bachelor of Public Administration degree from Barry University in 1999.
